pr_body:
The cgroups detection code ported from OpenJDK contained a bug
that made the cgroup factory return an empty optional result
on cgroups v2. On such a system, all cgroup hierarchy ids are 0
in /proc/cgroups, yet there is a /proc/self/mountinfo entry
for the cgroup2 pseudo filesystem. However, a later - or
previous - line in mountinfo not containing the cgroup filesystem
type would (wrongly) enter the if condition returning an empty
result.

The intention is to only return that if there really isn't any
cgroup pseudo filesystem mount.

Regression tests for the cgroup detection code have been added.

Closes #3992

Hmm, the remaining [gate failures](https://github.com/oracle/graal/runs/4774333741?check_suite_focus=true) seem to be caused by the gate using `--builder-on-modulepath`. Removing that option makes the gate pass.  The builder on module path option seems to be causing errors looking up method `determineType()` causing the assertion to be hit.

@olpaw @ivan-ristovic Any idea what would be needed to make the new test work in that setup too? `com.oracle.svm.core.containers.CgroupSubsystemFactory.determineType()` is part of the `org.graalvm.nativeimage.builder` module in `svm.jar`.

This works (no `--builder-on-modulepath`):

```
mx --primary-suite-path substratevm --J @-Xmx2g --java-home=/home/runner/work/graal/graal/jdk native-unittest --build-args '--features=com.oracle.svm.test.ImageInfoTest$TestFeature,com.oracle.svm.test.ServiceLoaderTest$TestFeature,com.oracle.svm.test.SecurityServiceTest$TestFeature' '-H:AdditionalSecurityProviders=com.oracle.svm.test.SecurityServiceTest$NoOpProvider' '-H:AdditionalSecurityServiceTypes=com.oracle.svm.test.SecurityServiceTest$JCACompliantNoOpService'
```

This doesn't:

```
mx --primary-suite-path substratevm --J @-Xmx2g --java-home=/home/runner/work/graal/graal/jdk native-unittest --builder-on-modulepath --build-args '--features=com.oracle.svm.test.ImageInfoTest$TestFeature,com.oracle.svm.test.ServiceLoaderTest$TestFeature,com.oracle.svm.test.SecurityServiceTest$TestFeature' '-H:AdditionalSecurityProviders=com.oracle.svm.test.SecurityServiceTest$NoOpProvider' '-H:AdditionalSecurityServiceTypes=com.oracle.svm.test.SecurityServiceTest$JCACompliantNoOpService'
```

> Hmm, the remaining [gate failures](https://github.com/oracle/graal/runs/4774333741?check_suite_focus=true) seem to be caused by the gate using `--builder-on-modulepath`. Removing that option makes the gate pass.

We are using `--builder-on-modulepath` to ensure newly added test are forced to take the module-aspect into account, i.e. removing it is not an option.

 The builder on module path option seems to be causing errors looking up method `determineType()` causing the assertion to be hit.

I will have a look what needs to be opened-up for this to work and let you know.

@jerboaa this should do the trick
```patch
diff --git a/substratevm/src/com.oracle.svm.test/src/META-INF/native-image/com.oracle.svm.test/native-image.properties b/substratevm/src/com.oracle.svm.test/src/META-INF/native-image/com.oracle.svm.test/native-image.properties
index a7ab262819b..7c5927eea72 100644
--- a/substratevm/src/com.oracle.svm.test/src/META-INF/native-image/com.oracle.svm.test/native-image.properties
+++ b/substratevm/src/com.oracle.svm.test/src/META-INF/native-image/com.oracle.svm.test/native-image.properties
@@ -1 +1,7 @@
-Args=--initialize-at-run-time=com.oracle.svm.test --initialize-at-build-time=com.oracle.svm.test.AbstractClassSerializationTest,com.oracle.svm.test.SerializationRegistrationTest --features=com.oracle.svm.test.SerializationRegistrationTestFeature -H:+AllowVMInspection --features=com.oracle.svm.test.AbstractServiceLoaderTest$TestFeature,com.oracle.svm.test.NoProviderConstructorServiceLoaderTest$TestFeature
+Args= \
+  --initialize-at-run-time=com.oracle.svm.test \
+  --initialize-at-build-time=com.oracle.svm.test.AbstractClassSerializationTest,com.oracle.svm.test.SerializationRegistrationTest \
+  --features=com.oracle.svm.test.SerializationRegistrationTestFeature \
+  -H:+AllowVMInspection \
+  --features=com.oracle.svm.test.AbstractServiceLoaderTest$TestFeature,com.oracle.svm.test.NoProviderConstructorServiceLoaderTest$TestFeature \
+  --add-exports=org.graalvm.nativeimage.builder/com.oracle.svm.core.containers=ALL-UNNAMED
```
Note, I'm only adding `--add-exports=org.graalvm.nativeimage.builder/com.oracle.svm.core.containers=ALL-UNNAMED` - the rest is just putting each native-image option in a different line to improve maintainability. I assume `com.oracle.svm.core.containers.CgroupSubsystemFactory#determineType` should not be exported generally and is only to be used by the tests, right?
